root.name: Danish Gambit Accepted: Svenonius Defense
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 Ne7

overview: After 3.c3 Black declines to take on c3 and plays 3...Ne7, preparing ...d5 and recapturing on d4. White can play 4.cxd4 d5 5.exd5 Nxd5 6.Nf3 getting a central d4 pawn against Black piece activity, or Bc4 lines. Black reaches a comfortable game and the gambit is effectively declined.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on d4 and build a centre with Nf3, Bc4
Use open lines against the king

black_ideas.idea: Strike with ...d5 to gain central space

typical_structures.structure: White d4/e4 centre against Black ...d5 pawn

character.notes: A sideline in which Black declines the gambit and the game becomes ordinary.

soundness.notes: A comfortable defence for Black, with White getting a normal open game.

approach.notes: The Danish is played now and then by strong players.

level.notes: Plans of piece activity versus central presence.

sublines_that_differ.name: Accepted 3...dxc3
sublines_that_differ.how: The real Danish Gambit, not this variation

character.reason: Black declines and the play is an ordinary open game.

structure.reason: The d- and e-pawn exchanges open the centre.

approach.reason: A sideline in an uncommon opening.

plans.reason: White tries to use open lines.
